text:
You need someone in Scarborough who can handle in-person admin support, Excel-based task tracking, email coordination, and light web/IT help for your property valuation business.

I’m Mina Castellan, with 5 years of experience in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization. I’ve built a Sales KPI dashboard for Marlowe Furniture using Power BI, DAX, SQL Server, and Excel, where I consolidated 14 separate Excel sales reports into one report and cut monthly close reporting from 3 days to 4 hours.

For your role, I can help with expense reports, spreadsheet tracking, email drafting, and organizing information clearly in Microsoft 365. I’m detail-oriented, reliable, and comfortable with structured administrative work.

Would you like someone who can start by setting up your task and expense tracking spreadsheets first?
